summary: Datavault AI Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register the issuance of warrants to purchase up to 2,727,272 shares of common stock solely as consideration to Maxim Group LLC under a settlement letter agreement. The warrants are not sold for cash; the company receives no proceeds. The stock closed at $0.40 on June 18, 2026. This is a routine registration of securities issued as a settlement fee and waiver of participation rights, not a stand-alone special situation. No special structural event like a tender offer or restructuring is present. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown with no unusual strategic implications.
